observations: Photo 0 shows a Nikon DSLR camera body with two attached/nearby lenses on a table.
The lens on the left appears to be a zoom lens with a front element and textured focus/zoom ring; the other lens appears to be a larger prime lens.
Brand name 'Nikon' is readable on the camera body (photo 0).
No clear model number (e.g., D3xxx/D5xxx/D7xxx) is readable from photo 0.
No clear lens markings (e.g., '18-55mm' or '50mm') are readable from photo 0.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows two lenses, but the lens focal-length markings (18-55mm and 50mm) are not clearly readable.

claims.claim: Clean and good to shoot videos and snapshots.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show sensor condition, shutter count, autofocus performance, video capability, or any test footage.

risks.risk: Exact camera model is unknown; pricing varies a lot by Nikon DSLR generation (and whether it supports video well).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the camera model name/number on the body (e.g., D3xxx/D5xxx/D7xxx) and the lens mount area/label if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Nikon DSLR kit with unknown model and assume worst-case for video performance (as not proven).

risks.risk: Lens focal lengths (18-55mm and 50mm) are not confirmed from the photo; could be different lenses or non-matching brands.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of each lens showing the printed focal length (e.g., '18-55mm' and '50mm') and lens model/series.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a Nikon DSLR kit with 2 unverified lenses (worst-case: treat as lower-value/unknown lenses).

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible: fungus/haze on glass, scratches, broken mounts, or worn focus/zoom mechanics.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up shots of both lens elements against light (front and rear glass) and a short video showing zoom/focus movement.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not-fully-verified condition (worst-case: assume possible wear and no guarantee of smooth operation).

risks.risk: Functionality not proven: shutter count, autofocus accuracy, exposure issues, and whether video works properly.
risks.proof: Ask for a short recorded clip (screen recording or live video) showing autofocus and video recording, plus a photo of the camera's shutter count screen/menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested for video and performance (worst-case: assume needs servicing).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, memory card, straps) can reduce value significantly.
risks.proof: Ask for a full contents photo laid out (battery, charger, cables, memory card, strap, lens caps, hood).
risks.if_unproven: Price as kit with only what is shown (worst-case: assume missing charger/battery or caps).

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the camera model number/name on the body (photo of the exact label).
Close-up photos of each lens showing printed focal length and lens model (18-55mm and 50mm confirmation).
Front and rear glass close-ups for both lenses (against light) to check fungus/haze/scratches.
Short test video showing autofocus and smooth zoom/focus, plus a still photo sample.
Photo of included accessories (battery, charger, memory card, lens caps/hood).
response.reason: The photo confirms a Nikon DSLR body and two lenses, but the key details that determine price (exact Nikon model and exact lens focal lengths/condition) are not readable or test-proven. Request the decisive close-ups and a quick functionality test before pricing.
